summary: The comment highlights the importance of E-Rate for providing essential digital resources to students and schools. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, citing the cost savings and benefits it provides for schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate could lead to increased costs for schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: As the Director of IT, the E-Rate discount for Internet connectivity and infrastructure has been essential for our school to provide our students with access to all of the following resources - their digital textbooks, their Blackbaud LMS and Naviance College & Career software in addition to their Microsoft 365 apps and OneDrive file storage.
